fusions.name: Flattened Swell
fusions.desc: Slaps the water flat around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Paddle Comes Down
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 34 damage that ignores armour, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and leaves it [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tempered Hide
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Calm
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you gain a shield of 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
